decision.message: Request excludes whole-board power reduction and battery operation explicitly, but these are not part of the configurable profiles. Please clarify if you want a profile with lower I2C pull-up current only, ignoring whole-board power or battery operation considerations.

clauses.text: Select the version that reduces I2C pull-up current.
clauses.reason: Request explicitly asks for reducing only I2C pull-up current, matching the low_current profile definition.

clauses.text: I do not mean reducing whole-board power or running on a battery.
clauses.reason: The user explicitly excludes reducing whole-board power or running on a battery, which are unrelated to configured profiles and not supported capabilities.
